🚨 Almost 14 million adults in England — 1 in 4 — can't access NHS dental care. Nearly half of practices are closed to new adult patients, with waits of up to 5 years in rural areas.

Labour's response is 700,000 extra appointments and £8 million. Against a crisis this size, that's a sticking plaster, not a fix.
